evidence.claim: Customer C02354 denies making the $39.08 purchase 3491361; the denial is the trigger evidence and floors the probability at 0.55 per bank history where customer-reported denials were never cleared without an R7 match.

recurring_charge_check on txn 3491361 found 17 prior product-W purchases within 1% of $39.08 in billing region 126.0 (median gap 5.0 days) but gap CV of 1.029, which exceeds the 0.6 ceiling required for the R7 recurring-pattern exception, so R7 does not apply and R2 governs this denial.

The card's modal region is 325.0 (4,788 prior in-person purchases across 149 days as of opening) while the flagged charge occurred in region 126.0, a secondary but well-used region (565 prior purchases across 141 days); the bank labels card-present fraud away from the modal region out_of_region_use even when the region is known to the card, matching the pattern documented for 581 of 955 of the bank's confirmed out_of_region_use cases.

episode_candidates around the flagged transaction shows a same-card, same-region in-person purchase 3485990 ($40.96 in region 126.0, ts 2016-11-25 13:26:35, two days earlier) with a cms_p of 0.837, the highest score in the 48h chain, though it does not sig_match the flagged transaction structurally.

This exact card carries 19 confirmed_fraud closed cases (account_takeover and out_of_region_use patterns, most recently CC-5558 opened 2016-11-01) against a single cleared case (CC-0405, confirmed-travel outcome), indicating a chronically compromised card rather than an isolated dispute.

The flagged $39.08 amount sits well under the card's prior median purchase of $86.91 (prior maximum $4,438.01 over 5,860 prior transactions as of opening), and the case-memory model itself scores this specific transaction at only 0.251 (calibrated 0.331), below the fraud band on its own.

card_testing_check, under_threshold_burst and shared_origin_scan on this card returned no small-then-large chain, no just-under-$500 burst, and no strong shared device or recipient-email fan-out connected to the flagged charge, so no card_testing, undocumented-ring, or R6 shared-origin evidence applies here.

case.summary: Verdict uncertain at p=0.55, labeled out_of_region_use since the $39.08 charge landed in region 126.0 away from the card's modal region 325.0. The chain-rule episode is transactions 3485990, 3490180 and 3491361, exposure $197.11 around the customer's denied charge. Decisive facts pull both ways: 19 prior confirmed-fraud cases on this card plus a 0.837 cms_p same-region neighbor (3485990) argue fraud, while the amount fits the card's baseline and a near-miss recurring pattern in region 126.0 (gap CV 1.03, just over the R7 threshold) argues ordinary use. Recommending CREATE_CASE and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST (auto) plus BLOCK_CARD pending L1 approval to resolve the conflict.
